sources.title: ODATA: Centros de datos hiperescalables en Colombia (Colombia locations page, Spanish)
sources.summary: ODATA's Colombia locations page says that in the Bogotá region 'El centro de datos BG01 está operativo y cuenta con capacidad disponible para grandes proyectos en la nube, inteligencia artificial y otras operaciones digitales críticas' and invites visits ('Programa una visita'). It lists one facility, Centro de datos BG01 at Zona Franca Metropolitana Cota, Edificio San Rafael, Vda. Vuelta Grande, Cota, Cundinamarca: the largest carrier-neutral data centre in Colombia, 6,400 m2 total and 5,500 m2 built area, Tier III design, 'Disponibilidad 24/7/365 / Acceso y funcionamiento continuos', slab-on-grade concrete and steel structure. It says the Colombian operation benefits from a free-zone regime and that SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001 and ISO 20000-1 certifications support BG01's operation, with backup generators, UPS and redundant power distribution. It gives no capacity in MW, opening date or map.

The August datePublished predates the public relaunch of ODATA's site and is not used. The version is bounded by dated second sources: ODATA's old odatacolocation.com facility pages were still archived as live pages on 16 September 2026 (Internet Archive copy of the DC ST01 page, source latam-south-p1-odata-dc-st01-ia-20260916), so the relaunched odatadc.com locations pages postdate that day; the Internet Archive copy of odatadc.com/page-sitemap.xml of 13 October 2026 (source latam-south-p1-odata-page-sitemap-ia-20261013) is byte-identical to the live sitemap of 23 October 2026 and already lists the Portuguese original of this page with the same modification instant; and the live capture of 23 October 2026 still carries that dateModified, so the page was not modified between 25 September and 23 October. No Internet Archive copy of this page or its Portuguese or canonical Spanish URL exists (CDX queries of 23 October 2026 returned none). published_at records the modification day of the captured version; its present-tense statement that BG01 is operating is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 25 September 2026, not an inspection day or opening date. The Spanish page is the site's GTranslate machine-translated rendering of the Portuguese original (https://odatadc.com/localidades-colombia/, source latam-south-p1-odata-colombia-locations-pt), which carries the same statement ('O Data Center BG01 está em operação, com capacidade disponível') and the same JSON-LD dates.

sources.title: ODATA fortalece sua presença no Chile e chega a 80MW de capacidade de TI no País (ODATA press note, 7 November 2023)
sources.summary: ODATA announces the inauguration of its second Chilean site, DC ST02, in the comuna of San Bernardo, Santiago, raising its Chilean IT capacity to about 80 MW. ST02 is its largest Chilean campus, with up to 40.6 MW of IT load, more than 34,000 m2 of construction, a dedicated on-site substation and 60 MVA supplied by dual feeds. ODATA also announces the expansion of its first Chilean campus, DC ST01, which received the construction of its second building and is supplied with 100% contracted renewable energy.

sources.title: QTS Data Centers: Irving data center campus
sources.summary: QTS's Irving campus page describes Irving 1 as one of QTS's Dallas-area mega data center campuses: a 56-acre master-planned campus of six facilities with 165 MW+ critical campus capacity. It lists DC1 and DC2 at 6431 Longhorn Dr, DC3 at 6351, DC4 at 6311, DC5 at 6300 and DC6 at 6440 Longhorn Dr, Irving, Texas 75063, and prints QTS's U.S. headquarters as 22271 Broderick Drive, Sterling, Virginia.
